in_greek.name: Δόλφος
in_greek.long_meaning: Δόλφος είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα που προέρχεται από τη γερμανική λέξη 'dolf', που σημαίνει 'βοηθός' ή 'υπηρέτης'. Το όνομα Δόλφος χρησιμοποιήθηκε στην πρώιμη Εκκλησία και συμβολίζει τη βοήθεια και την προστασία που προσφέρει ο Θεός στους ανθρώπους.

in_latin.name: Dolphus
in_latin.long_meaning: Dolphus is a Christian name derived from the Germanic word 'dolf', meaning 'wolf' or 'helper'. The name Dolphus was used in medieval Europe and signifies the idea of assistance and protection to others, reflecting the Christian values of charity and compassion.

data.cultural_impact: The name Dolphus gained popular usage during the Middle Aages in Europe, where it was influenced by the Greek and Roman mythology's view of the dolphin as a symbol of good fortune and protection, especially at sea. This association carried over into the Christian tradition, where the dolphin became a Christian symbol of divinity and God's protection over believers.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual context, the name Dolphus can be seen as a reminder of God's protection and guidance in times of turbulence or danger, just as a dolphin guides a ship through rough waters. It can also be seen as a symbol of the resurrection, as the dolphin was believed to have the power to revive drowning sailors and return them to the surface. Overall, the name Dolphus carries a sense of hope, protection, and Divine guidance.
